compiled_state.title: RED: Write corpus and holdout fixture tests
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Create tests/docs/test-inference-incident-corpus.sh as RED (failing) tests for the incidents.jsonl corpus and holdout.txt fixture files.

File to create:
- tests/docs/test-inference-incident-corpus.sh

Test functions (no live CLI calls, ticket_id validation by regex only):
- test_corpus_file_has_minimum_incidents: jq -s 'length' >= 20
- test_corpus_ticket_ids_match_format: all ticket_ids match ^[a-z0-9]{4}-[a-z0-9]{4}$ regex
- test_holdout_file_exists: holdout.txt exists at tests/fixtures/inference-incidents/holdout.txt
- test_holdout_entries_match_corpus_subset: pre-extract corpus ids with jq -r '.[].ticket_id' before loop, then grep each holdout entry against the pre-extracted string

Implementation notes:
- Count uses jq -s 'length' NOT wc -l
- Holdout loop pre-extracts corpus ids once to avoid O(n*m) jq passes: corpus_ids=; then grep against corpus_ids variable
- NO live .claude/scripts/dso ticket exists calls -- format regex only

RED markers added to .test-index (single line per source file):
- tests/fixtures/inference-incidents/incidents.jsonl: tests/docs/test-inference-incident-corpus.sh [test_corpus_file_has_minimum_incidents]
- tests/fixtures/inference-incidents/holdout.txt: tests/docs/test-inference-incident-corpus.sh [test_holdout_file_exists]

AC: All 4 functions fail before T6a creates the fixtures. No ruff checks (bash-only).

comments.body: PLAN_AMENDMENT: Holdout partition test should validate the hash algorithm. Add test_holdout_partition_uses_md5_algorithm: for each tid in holdout.txt, confirm that int(hashlib.md5(tid.encode()).hexdigest()[0:8], 16) % 3 == 0. This validates T6b used the correct deterministic hash function, not Python built-in hash() which is PYTHONHASHSEED-dependent. Use a Python one-liner or awk within the bash test: python3 -c "import hashlib,sys; [print(l.strip()) for l in sys.stdin if int(hashlib.md5(l.strip().encode()).hexdigest()[0:8],16)%3!=0]" < holdout.txt. If any ticket_id prints, assert fails.
